# TapOnLights API: guide for AI assistants and scripts

TapOnLights is a Windows app that controls TP-Link Tapo smart bulbs on a home network. This server is its web API. Everything the app's own controls can do, you can do here.

Base URL: {{BASE_URL}}

- **Auth:** if a request returns 401, use HTTP Basic auth with any username and the password the user gave you.
- **Bodies:** send JSON with the header `Content-Type: application/json`.
- **URL:** use the address above (an IP address or localhost). Requests to other hostnames are refused (403).

## How to work

1. `GET {{BASE_URL}}/api/snapshot` to see the bulbs (name, room, IP, status, current state) and the scenes.
2. Work out which bulbs the user means. Targets can be bulb IPs, bulb names or room names (case-insensitive). An empty list means every bulb. If the request is ambiguous, ask.
3. Send changes with `POST /api/command`. Change only what was asked.
4. Reply with a short summary of what changed. To confirm what the bulbs report, wait about 1 s, `POST /api/refresh`, wait about 1 s, then `GET /api/snapshot`.

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Body | Success |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | /api/snapshot | — | 200, JSON state (below) |
| POST | /api/command | `{"targets": [...], "patch": {...}}` | 204 |
| POST | /api/scenes/apply | `{"name": "Relax", "targets": [...]}` | 204 |
| POST | /api/scenes | `{"name": "Movie", "scene": {"brightness": 20, "color": null, "temperature": 2700}}` | 204 (saves a custom scene) |
| DELETE | /api/scenes/{name} | — | 204 (deletes a custom scene) |
| POST | /api/effects/start | `{"name": "candle", "targets": [...], "options": {...}}` | 204 (see Effects) |
| POST | /api/effects/stop | `{"targets": [...]}` | 204 (looping effects restore the earlier look) |
| POST | /api/refresh | — | 204 (re-read every bulb now) |
| GET | /api/events | — | server-sent events; a `snapshot` event with the full state on every change |
| GET | /api/settings | — | 200: bulbs list (IP, name, room) and theme |
| PUT | /api/settings | `{"devices": [...], "theme": "system"}` | 200; **replaces the whole bulb list**, so only use it when asked |

## Patch (the "patch" in /api/command)

All fields are optional, but at least one is required:

| Field | Values | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `on` | `true` / `false` | Power. `false` ignores the other fields. |
| `brightness` | 1–100 | Percent. Turns the bulb on. |
| `temperature` | 2500–6500 | White light in kelvin. Turns the bulb on and switches to white mode. |
| `color` | `{"hue": 0–360, "saturation": 1–100}` | Colored light. Turns the bulb on and switches to color mode. |

- Out-of-range numbers are clamped. Unknown fields are rejected (422).
- Don't send `color` and `temperature` together; if you do, `color` wins.
- Brightness can be combined with either.

### Picking values

- **Colors (hue):** red 0, orange 25, amber 40, yellow 55, lime 90, green 120, teal 170, cyan 185, blue 220, indigo 250, purple 275, magenta 300, pink 330. Use saturation 100 for vivid colors, 40–70 for pastels.
- **White tones (kelvin):** candlelight 2500, warm 2700, soft 3000, neutral 4000, cool 5000, daylight 6500.
- **Brightness:** night light 5–15, relaxed 30–50, normal 70–90, full 100.

## Effects

Animations that run inside the app; you don't need to keep sending requests. Names and options (all optional):

| Name | Effect | Options |
|---|---|---|
| `breathe` | brightness rises and falls slowly | `period` 3–60 s (default 8), `brightness` peak |
| `candle` | warm flicker | `brightness` base (default 60) |
| `colorLoop` | slow drift around the color wheel | `period` 10–600 s (default 60), `saturation` |
| `sunrise` | 1% / 2500 K up to full brightness at 4000 K | `minutes` 0.5–120 (default 15), `brightness` final |
| `sunset` | down to 1% / 2500 K, then off | `minutes` 0.5–120 (default 15) |
| `alert` | colored pulses, then back to the earlier look | `hue` (default 0, red), `saturation`, `times` 1–10 (default 3) |

- Any manual change to a bulb (`/api/command`, a scene) stops its effect.
- `/api/effects/stop` restores the earlier look for `breathe`, `candle` and `colorLoop`.
- Each bulb's `effect` field in the snapshot shows what's running.
- Prefer these over fast loops of `/api/command`: they're smoother and gentler on the bulbs.

## Snapshot fields

- **`bulbs[]`:**
  - `ip`, `name`, `room`, `model`, `firmware`
  - `status`: `online`, `connecting`, `offline` or `authError`; `error` explains anything other than online
  - `on`, `brightness`
  - `mode`: `white` or `color`
  - `temperature`, `hue`, `saturation` (the last values set, whichever mode is active)
  - `signal`: Wi-Fi signal level, 0–3
  - `effect`: the running effect, or null
- **`scenes[]`:** `name`, `builtin`, `brightness`, `temperature` (or null), `color` (or null).
- **Also:** `temperatureRange`, and `web` (the server's status).

Bulbs that aren't `online` won't respond until they reconnect, and the app retries every 15 s. Tell the user and include the `error` text.

## Timing

- **A change** is accepted at once (204), shows in the snapshot right away, and reaches the bulb in about 0.1–0.2 s.
- **Fades and sequences:** for gradual changes, send steps at least 150 ms apart. Faster requests are merged, and only the latest value is sent.

## Examples

```sh
# Everything off
curl -X POST {{BASE_URL}}/api/command -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"targets": [], "patch": {"on": false}}'

# Warm, dim light in the Office room
curl -X POST {{BASE_URL}}/api/command -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"targets": ["Office"], "patch": {"brightness": 30, "temperature": 2700}}'

# One bulb blue
curl -X POST {{BASE_URL}}/api/command -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"targets": ["Back"], "patch": {"color": {"hue": 220, "saturation": 100}}}'

# A scene everywhere
curl -X POST {{BASE_URL}}/api/scenes/apply -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name": "Relax", "targets": []}'

# Wake-up light over 20 minutes in the Bedroom
curl -X POST {{BASE_URL}}/api/effects/start -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name": "sunrise", "targets": ["Bedroom"], "options": {"minutes": 20}}'

# With a password (any username)
curl -u "me:PASSWORD" {{BASE_URL}}/api/snapshot
```

In Windows PowerShell, `curl` is an alias for Invoke-WebRequest, so call `curl.exe`, or use:

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri {{BASE_URL}}/api/command -ContentType "application/json" -Body '{"targets": [], "patch": {"brightness": 60}}'
```

## Errors

- **400:** a plain-text message, for example an unknown bulb or room (the message lists the known bulbs), an unknown scene, or an empty patch.
- **401:** password required or wrong.
- **403:** use an IP address or localhost in the URL.
- **404:** unknown endpoint.
- **415:** missing `Content-Type: application/json`.
- **422:** the JSON has the wrong shape or an unknown field; the message says which.

## Rules

- Don't change settings (`PUT /api/settings`) or delete scenes unless the user asks for exactly that.
- The account password, startup options and web-access settings can't be changed through this API.
